scope: Syphon Beta16 urllib3-fixed yt-dlp build; excludes curl_cffi, CPython and PyInstaller
authentication: Retained HTTPS PyPI metadata digests checked against archives and wheels. No independent signature or compiler provenance attestation.

runtimeEvidence.method: Parse literal PKG TOC; map every selected native wheel path to entry; compare wheel-member SHA256 to referenced build input. This proves build graph/input identity, not independent extraction of the final signed installer.

packages.name: cffi
limitations: Windows x64 recipe links bundled win64.obj; matching assembly win64.asm is retained. Regeneration with MASM is possible but was not run or compared. Vendored libffi file identities are established by archive/member hashes; no invented upstream libffi release number. ARM64 ffi.lib is outside this x64 review.

assemblerRegenerationRecipe.basis: Engineering command derived from retained MASM-compatible source and setup.py manual-regeneration instruction; not executed; exact original assembler flags not attested.

packages.name: charset-normalizer
limitations: setup.py uses Cython, not mypyc. CHARSET_NORMALIZER_USE_CYTHON=1 enables md.pyx and cd.pyx; exact Cython generator version and generated C translation units are absent from sdist and not established by this review. Generator/toolchain provenance is not a claim of missing package source or a legal conclusion.

Cython COPYING.txt at the retained reference commit explicitly says compilation output including embedded snippets carries no Cython license restrictions. This current upstream statement is reference evidence, not proof of the wheel generator version. Cython source retention is therefore not identified as a package-source closure blocker by this engineering review.

packages.name: setuptools
limitations: No native wheel member appears in PKG TOC. These launcher executables are build inputs, not established shipped runtime components. launcher.c source retained; launcher reproducibility not assessed.

currentRuntimeBinding.note: All47 reviewed wheel-native file hashes are unchanged. Historical build graph is supplemented by direct CArchive inspection of current executable.
